title: Apply for a high risk work licence assessment enrolment number
summary: This page explains how to apply online for an assessment enrolment number required for high risk work (HRW) training.
intro:
High risk work (HRW) training is provided by registered training organisations (RTO).

As part of the training you will be assessed for competency in your chosen class or classes of HRW. Assessments are provided by SafeWork NSW accredited assessors who work for the RTO.

To be eligible for assessment you need to apply for an assessment enrolment number online. Once your application is complete you'll get an email with your enrolment number and next steps.

If you are unable to apply for an assessment enrolment number online, contact us on 13 77 88.
what_you_need: The names of the licence classes you want to be assessed for
Your current HRW licence (if you have one)
Two documents from list 1, or one document from list 1 and one document from list 2 (to verify identity)
Australian certificate of registration by descent
Aviation and Maritime Security Identification card

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to apply for an assessment number.
We'll send you a confirmation email after you apply. The email will have your assessment enrolment number in it and next steps.
You'll need to contact your RTO for course and assessment details.
For your assessment you'll need to bring:
Once your assessment has been completed, you'll get an email to tell you how to apply for your licence.

more_info.text: If you’ve moved permanently to NSW from another state or territory, you’ll need to transfer your licence to NSW. You can transfer your licence to NSW if it’s current or not more than 12 months past its expiry date.
To find your high risk work licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.
Find help and information about MyServiceNSW Accounts.

faqs.q: Who can apply for an assessment enrolment number?
faqs.a: You must be aged 18 or over.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for an assessment enrolment number?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, the names of the licence classes you want to be assessed for, your current HRW licence (if you have one), and required identity documents.

faqs.q: What happens after I apply for the enrolment number?
faqs.a: You will receive a confirmation email with your assessment enrolment number and next steps. You must then contact your RTO for course and assessment details.
